messages:
sara-ng: Heads up — us-west-2 GPUs sustained ~98% utilization for the last 3h, p95 token latency up ~40%. Alert from infra-bot came in at 16:02. We keep rejecting bursts today; customers see 5xxs on free tier.

jburt: Got the alert. Current immediate-reject policy reduces overload but spikes customer errors + retries. Cost of retries is visible in burst billing. Need a gentler option.

mike_h: Proposal: try a regional "grace window" hybrid — short queue (100–250ms) then fall back to degrade instead of straight reject for paying tiers. Free tier still gets fast reject. This buys KV/cache hits and avoids some retry storms.

sara-ng: Love the idea. Key tradeoffs: increased tail latency for some requests vs fewer hard errors and lower retry amplification. Also needs plumbed metrics for per-tenant error budget and cost delta.

mike_h: Minimal config sketch (canary):
```
admission_policy:
  max_queue_ms: 200
  degrade_after_ms: 120
  actions:
    enterprise: fallback_model: "opt-small-v2"
    standard: reduce_concurrency: 0.6
    free: reject: true
  region_routing: prefer-warm-pool: true
```

jburt: Nice. Ops checklist: 1) canary in single AZ (us-west-2a) at 10% traffic, 2) 72h run, 3) monitor p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate by tier, cost/token delta, retry amplification. Rollback if enterprise SLOs degrade >0.3%.

sara-ng: Also add network egress spike watch — degraded responses might change payload size. Add a quick smoke that forces cached KV path to verify correctness on fallback.

infra-bot: Incident note attached: alert#1821 created; canary job template ready at /ops/canaries/grace-window.

jburt: I'll own the canary rollout. mike_h can you craft the rollout automation? sara-ng will own the telemetry dashboard. Starting Monday morning 09:00 PT unless objections.

mike_h: On it — will PR automation + feature flag gating. I'll include a per-tenant opt-out toggle for customers that want strict rejects.

sara-ng: No objections from me. If the 72h canary looks good, we expand to region-level ramp (20% -> 50% -> 100%) with 24h holds. :thumbsup:

jburt: Thanks — posting the runbook and checklist in #eng-infra/runbooks after PR merge.
